output.summary: Trailing perennial herb native to the Gulf Coast of eastern Mexico, from Tamaulipas to Yucatan. Wild plants are washed-out grey-green-purple, while the commercially grown 'Purpurea' cultivar has purple-violet leaves and stems. Its three-petalled flowers open only in the morning.
output.edibilityNote: The leaves have been used as food colourants and preservatives.
